source.citation: Suit, French, 1902, wool and silk: bodice, skirt and coat. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Costume Institute, C.I.50.108a-c, Gift of Mrs. Lincoln Cromwell, 1950; the museum's open-access object photographs CI50.108a F, CI50.108b F and CI50.108c F.
what_it_does_not_supply: how the suit sat on a living woman, or a hat
anything about Chicago, the Glessner household or Frances M. Glessner
what_it_supplies: the black of a lady's wool day suit of the decade, and its cream lace collar
a gored skirt close at the hips and flaring to the hem; a coat to the upper thigh, closed below the bust, with lapels above
